title: Consolidate shared probe-case collection admission across CPU and CUDA Tensor diagnostics

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

objective: Remove the verbatim bounded ProbeCase collection admission duplicated by CPU and CUDA run_probe without adding another Tensor abstraction or moving backend-specific policy into shared Fourfold semantics.

shared_rules: require every entry to be ProbeCase
normalize the admitted bounded collection to an immutable tuple
implementation.cpu: cpu_bitset_baseline.run_probe now composes the shared validator and contains no duplicate collection admission.
implementation.cuda: cuda_boolean_probe.run_probe now composes the shared validator; one-dtype-per-run remains CUDA-local after shared admission.
tests: pin CPU and CUDA imports and run_probe globals to the same validate_probe_cases function object
prove str/bytes, empty, over-bound and non-ProbeCase collections fail through the shared owner
prove accepted mutable sequence input normalizes to an immutable tuple
prove mixed-dtype rejection remains local to CUDA after common admission

preserved_boundaries.semantic_authority: The revision-bound Fourfold Project Twin/Forest and TypedRelationBlock remain authoritative; probe-case admission is diagnostic input validation only.
preserved_boundaries.physical_arms: CPU execution/sampling and CUDA device/dtype/memory/OOM policy remain separate physical concerns.
preserved_boundaries.no_parallel_abstraction: No new module, backend, registry, store, cache, scheduler, graph authority, public concept or semantic plane was added.
preserved_boundaries.evidence: Blocked/negative CUDA outcomes remain first-class evidence and cannot be converted to success by shared admission.

primary_acceptance.coverage: Python 3.10/3.12 hash-seed matrix, integrated tests/twin contract surface, isolated wheel import, repository collection and configured Fourfold/Tensor diagnostics

additional_surfaces.workflow: Ikarus tensor, Genesis and hopping contracts

verification.full_repository_execution: Complete suite remains workflow_dispatch-only and is not claimed by this packet.

result.summary: CPU and CUDA Tensor diagnostics now have one bounded collection-admission owner in the existing shared contract while backend-specific policy stays local.
result.gardener_effect: Removes duplicated validation logic and unused MAX_CASES imports from the physical arms instead of adding a second runner abstraction.
result.negative_claim: No speedup, Tensor-Core use, production Tensor adoption, Tensor-vs-Forest superiority, benchmark superiority, Gate progress, OwnerApproval or promotion is established.

rollback.boundary: Revert the GPU-180 implementation commits and this packet only; no production semantic migration or archive mutation is involved.
